set -eu
umask 077
mkdir -p /root/.ssh
chmod 700 /root/.ssh
touch /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
grep -Fqx "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" /root/.ssh/authorized_keys || printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
[ -s /etc/raddb/node2.secret ] || { dd if=/dev/urandom bs=32 count=1 2>/dev/null | base64 | tr -d '\n' > /etc/raddb/node2.secret; printf '\n' >> /etc/raddb/node2.secret; }
chown root:radius /etc/raddb/node2.secret
chmod 640 /etc/raddb/node2.secret
u=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration user:[[:space:]]*//p' /srv/legacy2/radius-network-authentication/access.txt)
p=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration password:[REDACTED]]]]]*//p' /srv/legacy2/radius-network-authentication/access.txt)
[ -n "$u" ]
[ -n "$p" ]
uq=$(printf '%s' "$u" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
pq=$(printf '%s' "$p" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
sed -i '/^# BEGIN ANTRIEB LEGACY USER$/,/^# END ANTRIEB LEGACY USER$/d' /etc/raddb/mods-config/files/authorize
{
  printf '\n# BEGIN ANTRIEB LEGACY USER\n'
  printf '"%s" Cleartext-Password :[REDACTED]]] "%s"\n' "$uq" "$pq"
  printf '# END ANTRIEB LEGACY USER\n'
} >> /etc/raddb/mods-config/files/authorize
node2_ip=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2 == "node2" {print $1; exit}')
[ -n "$node2_ip" ]
secret=[REDACTED]]] -d '\r\n' < /etc/raddb/node2.secret)
sed -i '/^# BEGIN ANTRIEB NODE2 CLIENT$/,/^# END ANTRIEB NODE2 CLIENT$/d' /etc/raddb/clients.conf
{
  printf '\n# BEGIN ANTRIEB NODE2 CLIENT\n'
  printf 'client legacy_node2 {\n'
  printf '    ipaddr = %s\n' "$node2_ip"
  printf '    secret = [REDACTED]]] "$secret"
  printf '    shortname = legacy-node2\n'
  printf '}\n'
  printf '# END ANTRIEB NODE2 CLIENT\n'
} >> /etc/raddb/clients.conf

commands.command:
set -eu
rm -f /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 /root/.ssh/known_hosts
printf 'TEMP_TRANSFER_KEY_REMOVED=YES\n'
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'CLIENT_SECRET_PRESENT=[REDACTED]]]YES\n'
printf 'HANDOVER_ACCESS_SHA256='; sha256sum /srv/legacy2/radius-network-authentication/access.txt | cut -d' ' -f1
printf 'HANDOVER_NOTES_SHA256='; sha256sum /srv/legacy2/radius-network-authentication/client-notes.txt | cut -d' ' -f1
u=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration user:[[:space:]]*//p' /srv/legacy2/radius-network-authentication/access.txt)
p=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration password:[REDACTED]]]]]*//p' /srv/legacy2/radius-network-authentication/access.txt)
s=$(tr -d '\r\n' < /etc/radius-node1.secret)
node1_ip=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2 == "node1" {print $1; exit}')
radtest -t pap "$u" "$p" "$node1_ip" 0 "$s" > /tmp/rad-final-health.log 2>&1
printf 'FINAL_AUTH='; grep -q 'Received Access-Accept' /tmp/rad-final-health.log && printf 'ACCESS_ACCEPT\n'
commands.stdout:
TEMP_TRANSFER_KEY_REMOVED=YES
BOOT_ID=61901e2e-f299-41cc-b523-b039dcdd2717
CLIENT_SECRET_PRESENT=[REDACTED]]]]
